info.title: NiChart API
info.summary: Backend API for the NiChart medical-imaging pipeline platform.
info.description:
Provides endpoints for managing projects, uploading imaging data, running containerised processing pipelines (locally via Docker or on AWS Batch), and retrieving results. 

**Authentication**: In cloud mode the server uses a BFF OAuth2 flow with Cognito. Tokens are stored in httpOnly cookies — never in JS-accessible storage. Navigate the browser to ``GET /auth/login`` to begin sign-in; all subsequent API requests carry the session cookie automatically. In local mode (``NICHART_EXECUTION_MODE=local``) authentication is bypassed.

get.description: Generates a CSRF ``state`` and PKCE ``code_verifier``/``code_challenge``, stores them in short-lived httpOnly cookies, then redirects the browser to the Cognito Hosted UI authorization endpoint. Navigate the browser (not a fetch/XHR) to this URL to start sign-in.

get.summary: OAuth2 callback — exchange code for session
get.description: Cognito redirects here after the user authenticates. Validates the CSRF ``state`` cookie, exchanges the authorization code for tokens (using the PKCE verifier + client secret), verifies the ID token, sets the ``session`` cookie, and redirects to the frontend. This endpoint is called by the browser following a redirect — not by JS fetch.

302.description: Redirect to frontend after successful authentication.

post.description: Uses the ``refresh_token`` httpOnly cookie to obtain a new ID token from Cognito and updates the ``session`` cookie. Returns updated user claims on success. Returns 401 when there is no refresh token or it has expired — the client should redirect to ``GET /auth/login``.

401.description: No refresh token or token expired.

get.description: Reads the ``session`` cookie and returns safe user claims if the session is valid. The frontend should poll this endpoint to determine auth state on page load. Returns 401 when there is no session or it has expired — the client should redirect to ``GET /auth/login``. In local mode, always returns the OS user without a cookie.

Clears the ``session`` and ``refresh_token`` cookies, then redirects to the Cognito logout URL (which itself redirects to the configured frontend URL). Navigate the browser to this URL — do not call it via fetch/XHR.
Returns a summary of every pipeline defined in the resources/pipelines directory. Use ``GET /catalog/pipelines/{pipeline_id}`` to retrieve the full definition.

schema.title: Response List Pipelines Catalog Pipelines Get

get.description: Returns the full pipeline definition: description, categories, data requirements, and ordered steps with their tool and I/O mappings.

Returns every imaging modality the platform recognizes — the code (also the study subdirectory name and the key used in NIfTI uploads and pipeline ``needs_<code>`` requirements) and a human label. Clients should read this rather than hard-coding the modality list.

schema.title: Response List Modalities Catalog Modalities Get

get.description: Returns a summary of every tool defined in the resources/tools directory.

schema.title: Response List Tools Catalog Tools Get

get.description: Returns the full tool specification: inputs, outputs, resource requirements, configurable parameters, and the per-subject time estimate used for queue-drain calculations.

Returns per-variable display metadata that controls how variables appear in the centile plotting variable selector. Only variables with non-default behaviour are included in the ``features`` map; variables absent from the map should be treated as visible and enabled. 

This metadata is maintained in a static server-side config file (``resources/reference_data/centiles/feature_metadata.yaml``) so that display policy is never hard-coded in the frontend.

get.summary: Get the curated variable-group and ROI-list catalog
get.description:
Returns the cross-pipeline variable grouping taxonomy that drives the variable browser: group -> variable, or group -> ROI sub-list -> variable for large index-based ROI groups like DLMUSE/DLWMLS volumes. 

Maintained in static server-side config files (``resources/dicts/dict_var_groups.yaml`` and ``dict_roi_lists.yaml``). A group's variables are named explicitly via ``values``, or, for large ROI-indexed sets, built from a ``prefix`` combined with an index from one of the ``roi_lists`` — resolve display names via the owning pipeline's ``label_map`` (``GET /catalog/pipelines/{pipeline_id}``).

Serves static resource files from the server's ``resources/`` directory: atlases, label maps, normative data CSVs, and other reference data. No authentication required. Responses are cached for 24 hours.

Returns a summary of every documentation topic in resources/docs/. Each topic may cover one or more related pipelines (e.g. harmonized and base DLMUSE variants share a single 'dlmuse' topic). No authentication required.

schema.title: Response List Docs Catalog Docs Get

get.description: Returns the manifest for a documentation topic: its sections, audience tags, and the pipeline IDs it covers. Use the ``file`` field of each section with ``GET /catalog/docs/{docs_id}/{file}`` to fetch the actual content. No authentication required.

Serves any file within the documentation topic folder: markdown prose, images, or JSON data. Relative image references in markdown files resolve naturally to further requests under this same path prefix. Path traversal outside the topic folder is rejected. No authentication required.
Returns the number of running and pending jobs on the AWS Batch queue and a rough estimate of how long until the queue drains. In local mode all job-count fields are null. No authentication required.

503.description: Could not reach the AWS Batch API.

get.description: Returns all projects owned by the authenticated user.

post.description:
Creates a new project directory. The project name is used as the directory name and URL path segment. Must match ``^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,63}$``. 

In cloud mode a retention heartbeat is written to S3 as part of creation, which starts the PROJECT_RETENTION_DAYS countdown.

409.description: A project with that name already exists.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the project and all its data. Irreversible.

get.description:
Returns the expiry timestamp for the project. The countdown resets each time ``POST /projects/{project_id}/retention/refresh`` is called. 

Returns 404 when the heartbeat object is absent — this is expected for projects created before this feature shipped; the Lambda sweep will backfill the heartbeat on its next daily run, after which this endpoint will return a value.

Cloud mode only — returns 404 in local mode.

404.description: Project not found or heartbeat not yet written (legacy project or creation race).

post.description:
Resets the retention countdown by overwriting the heartbeat marker with the current timestamp. Returns the new expiry time (now + PROJECT_RETENTION_DAYS). 

If the heartbeat was previously absent (legacy project) this call creates it, which is equivalent to a fresh creation. 

Cloud mode only — returns 404 in local mode.

404.description: Project not found or heartbeat not yet written (legacy project or creation race).

get.description: Returns a flat listing of all visible files and directories in the project. Internal staging (``_upload/``) and working (``_working/``) directories are excluded.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the file or directory at ``path``.

post.summary: Bundle a multi-file/directory selection into one zip
post.description: Bundles an arbitrary set of files and/or directories into a single zip archive, preserving each entry's path relative to the project root. Useful for downloading a multi-selection from the file browser as one archive instead of one request per item. Named to avoid 'download' in the URL, which some ad-blocker/privacy extensions filter.

Accepts one or more ``.nii`` / ``.nii.gz`` files (including a folder upload, where filenames carry relative directory paths). Files land in the project staging area and the server returns its best-effort MRID and modality inference. If two entries flatten to the same filename, the first one wins and the rest are reported in ``skipped_duplicates``. Follow up with the commit endpoint to move them into the project.

post.summary: Upload a zip of NIfTI files to staging
post.description: Accepts a ``.zip`` archive containing ``.nii`` / ``.nii.gz`` files (subdirectories are searched recursively; non-NIfTI entries are ignored). Files land in the project staging area and the server returns its best-effort MRID and modality inference. Directory components in the archive path contribute to modality detection (e.g. ``fl/subject001.nii.gz`` infers modality ``fl``). Nested directories are flattened into a single staging folder; if two entries flatten to the same filename, the first one wins and the rest are reported in ``skipped_duplicates``. Follow up with the commit endpoint to move them into the project.

Confirms MRID and modality mappings for staged files and moves them into their final locations. Every staged file must appear in ``mappings``. If a subject already has a file at the target modality/MRID slot, the new upload is left in place there and the mapping is reported in ``skipped`` instead of ``committed`` — existing scans are never overwritten by a re-upload.

delete.description: Deletes all files in the staging area without committing.

post.description: Replaces ``participants/participants.csv`` with the uploaded file. The file is stored as-is; must have at least an ``MRID`` column.

Accepts a ``.zip`` archive containing a BIDS-layout dataset, extracts it, and reorganises it into the NiChart project layout. ``sub-{id}_T1w.nii.gz`` → ``t1/{id}.nii.gz``, ``_FLAIR`` → ``fl/``, etc. A ``participants.tsv`` at the archive root is converted to ``participants/participants.csv``.

Accepts one or more files as multipart form data representing a BIDS dataset. Filenames may include relative sub-paths (e.g. ``sub-01/anat/sub-01_T1w.nii.gz``) and are validated for path traversal before writing. Reorganisation into the NiChart project layout is identical to the ZIP upload.
Accepts a ``.zip`` of ``.idat`` files. Extracted to ``idat/`` in the project.

Accepts one or more ``.idat`` files as multipart form data. Filenames must be flat (no directory separators) and end with ``.idat``. Each filename is validated before any file is written to ``idat/``.

get.description: Returns the contents of ``participants/participants.csv`` as JSON rows.

patch.description: Overwrites ``participants/participants.csv`` with the provided rows. Full replacement — rows not included are removed.

get.description: Returns a CSV template pre-populated with all MRIDs detected from committed NIfTI files in the project's modality directories. Rows already present in participants.csv retain their values; newly detected MRIDs appear with empty additional columns. Use this as a starting point for filling in demographic or clinical data before uploading.

Evaluates whether the project has the data required to run a pipeline. Returns a per-requirement status so the client can guide users to upload missing imaging data or fill missing participants.csv columns. Imaging checks scan the modality directories (``t1/``, ``fl/``, etc.) for NIfTI files. CSV checks verify that required columns exist and are non-empty for every subject.

Scans all ``_provenance.json`` files written by the pipeline executor after each successful step, then checks whether any recorded input paths have been modified since the step finished. A 'dirty' entry means the step's cached result may be stale and the step should re-run. A 'missing_inputs' entry means a required input no longer exists. Returns 'no_provenance' summary when no steps have completed yet.

post.description: Accepts a single ``.zip`` archive of DICOM files. The archive is extracted with symlink and path-traversal checks into a private staging area. Use the returned ``staging_id`` to inspect series and submit a conversion job.

404.description: Project or staging area not found.

post.summary: Upload individual DICOM files to staging
post.description: Accepts one or more raw DICOM files as multipart form data. Each filename is validated (no path traversal, no directory separators). Files are staged identically to the ZIP upload — use the returned ``staging_id`` with the inspect and convert endpoints.

404.description: Project or staging area not found.

get.description: Reads DICOM headers (via pydicom) in the staging area and returns a list of detected series with their description, modality, study date, and file count. No conversion happens at this step — it is safe to call multiple times.

404.description: Project or staging area not found.

post.description: Accepts a mapping of DICOM series UIDs to NiChart modality labels and submits a dcm2niix conversion job for each selected series. Series not listed are ignored. Returns a ``run_id`` for polling via ``GET /jobs/pipelines/{run_id}``.

404.description: Project or staging area not found.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the staged DICOM files without converting them. Staging areas are also auto-cleaned after ``NICHART_STAGING_TTL_HOURS``.

404.description: Project or staging area not found.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous pipeline run for the given project. The server spawns a background task that executes each pipeline step in order, polling the job backend between steps. Use the returned ``run_id`` to track progress via ``GET /jobs/pipelines/{run_id}``.

post.summary: Plan a pipeline run without submitting it
post.description:
Predicts how a submission would execute right now: which steps would be reused from the step cache, which would run, and roughly how long the run would take.

Read-only — creates no run record, submits no jobs and does not touch the step cache. It stats input/output paths and reads the cache metadata, so it is cheap enough to call whenever the pipeline, params or reuse toggle change.

Takes the same body as the submit route, including ``start_from_step``. Estimates assume **serial** execution: they are not divided by chunks or workers, because chunking is not guaranteed and chunks need not run concurrently.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's pipeline runs in reverse-chronological order. Pass ``project_id`` to filter to a single project.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Maximum number of runs to return.
schema.title: Limit

parameters.description: Maximum number of runs to return.

schema.title: Response List Pipeline Runs Jobs Pipelines Get

get.summary: Poll for newly finished pipeline runs
get.description:
Returns all pipeline runs that reached a terminal state (``succeeded`` or ``failed``) since the last time this endpoint was called by the authenticated user. The server stores a per-user cursor so only genuinely new completions are returned on each call. 

**First call**: the cursor defaults to epoch, so all existing terminal runs are returned — useful for bootstrapping a UI on first load. 

Designed for lightweight notification polling (e.g. every 10–30 seconds). For full run history use ``GET /jobs/pipelines``.

Returns the full run record including per-step status, timestamps, and any error messages. In cloud mode, while a step is actively waiting on the Batch queue, ``jobs_ahead`` and ``estimated_wait_seconds`` are populated by querying all jobs submitted to the queue before this one. These fields are null in local mode or once a job has left the queue.

delete.description: Requests cancellation of a running pipeline. The currently executing tool step is cancelled on the backend; subsequent steps will not be submitted. No-op if the run is already in a terminal state.

get.description: Returns concatenated log output from all steps completed so far. Poll this endpoint alongside the status endpoint during a run.

get.summary: Get logs for a single parallel chunk
get.description: Returns the captured log output for one chunk of a parallelised pipeline step. Only available after the chunk has started executing. Use ``GET /jobs/pipelines/{run_id}/logs`` to retrieve all chunks concatenated.

schema.title: Response Get Chunk Logs Jobs Pipelines  Run Id  Steps  Step Id  Chunks  Chunk Idx  Logs Get

400.description: Step was not run in parallel chunks.

404.description: Run, step, or chunk not found.

get.description: Returns a summary for every pipeline that declares a ``results:`` section in its YAML. Summaries indicate which output types are present in the project. Use this to discover which pipelines have results to visualize — one call covers all pipelines.

schema.title: Response List Results Projects  Project Id  Results Get

get.summary: Get full result detail for a pipeline
get.description:
Returns the complete result structure for one pipeline: feature columns, label map (column → segmentation label IDs for overlay rendering), per-subject file availability, subject completeness, and resource paths for the atlas NIfTI and normative data CSV. 

**Atlas and normative data** are fetched via ``GET /catalog/resources/{path}`` (public, no auth required, cached 24 h).
Returns server status and the active execution mode. No authentication required.

download_path.title: Download Path
download_path.description: Relative path for use with GET /projects/{id}/files/download.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Feature columns in the CSV (MRID column excluded).

feature_definitions.title: Feature Definitions
feature_definitions.description: Semantic definitions keyed by feature column name — definition, units, direction, interpretation, literature keywords, and curated references. Authored in the pipeline YAML. Only documented columns appear here; a column absent from this map has no authored definition. Null when the pipeline declares no feature definitions.

label_map.title: Label Map
label_map.description: Maps each feature column to its segmentation label information. Columns not present in the label map have no segmentation correspondence. Present only when a label_map resource is declared in the pipeline YAML.

column_units.title: Column Units
column_units.description: Maps each feature column name to its unit string (e.g. 'mm³', 'years', 'a.u.'). Populated from ``default_unit`` / ``column_units`` in the pipeline YAML. For segmentation pipelines the unit is also present on each ``label_map`` entry. Null when no units are declared for this pipeline.

BatchFeaturesResult.description: Summary of the pipeline's batch-level feature CSV.

features.title: Features
features.description: Per-variable display metadata keyed by variable name (matching VarName in the centile CSVs). Only variables with non-default behaviour are included; variables absent from this map should be treated as visible and enabled.

pending_job_count.title: Pending Job Count

estimated_queue_drain_seconds.description: Rough estimate of seconds until the queue is empty, computed as the sum of (time_per_subject_seconds × num_subjects) across all running and pending jobs. Null when no per-job subject counts are available.

CloudStatusResponse.title: CloudStatusResponse
CloudStatusResponse.description:
Current cloud service busyness as reported by the AWS Batch queue.

In local mode all job-count fields are ``null`` and ``mode`` is ``"local"``.

Display metadata for a single feature column.

When present, the values are the voxel intensities in the atlas segmentation that

For pipelines without segmentation output, ``label_map`` on ``PipelineDetail``
will be null rather than containing ``LabelInfo`` entries with empty label_ids.

recommended.description: Recommended total number of subjects for reliable results.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: Per-cohort minimums, e.g. 'at least 30 subjects with DX == CN'. Empty when the pipeline declares none.

MinSubjectsSpec.title: MinSubjectsSpec
MinSubjectsSpec.description:
Declared subject-count requirement, with optional per-cohort minimums.

Thresholds are returned with pipeline-YAML defaults already resolved, so a
client never has to replicate the defaulting rules.

code.title: Code
code.description: Canonical modality code — also the study subdirectory name and the key used in uploads/requirements.

dir.title: Dir
dir.description: Study subdirectory where images of this modality are stored (${STUDY}/{dir}/).

ModalityInfo.title: ModalityInfo
ModalityInfo.description: An imaging modality the platform recognizes.

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.description: One entry per staged file; every staged file must be accounted for.

NiftiCommitRequest.title: NiftiCommitRequest
NiftiCommitRequest.description: Request body for the NIfTI staging commit endpoint.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Entries whose target file already existed and were left untouched instead of being overwritten.

NiftiCommitResult.title: NiftiCommitResult
NiftiCommitResult.description: Response after a successful NIfTI commit.

filename.title: Filename
filename.description: Filename as returned in the staging proposals.

mrid.title: Mrid
mrid.description: Subject identifier. Becomes the file stem in the target directory.

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: NiChart modality code (see GET /catalog/modalities). Determines which subdirectory the file lands in.

NiftiMapping.title: NiftiMapping
NiftiMapping.description: Confirmed mapping for a single staged NIfTI file.

staging_id.title: Staging Id
staging_id.description: Opaque staging area identifier. Pass to the commit endpoint.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.description: Server's best-effort mapping of filenames to MRID and modality.

skipped_duplicates.title: Skipped Duplicates
skipped_duplicates.description: Original relative paths that were skipped because they flattened to the same filename as an earlier entry in this upload (first occurrence wins).

NiftiStagingResult.title: NiftiStagingResult
NiftiStagingResult.description: Response after uploading NIfTI file(s); requires a follow-up commit call.

inferred_mrid.title: Inferred Mrid
inferred_mrid.description: MRID inferred from the filename by stripping known suffixes.

inferred_modality.title: Inferred Modality
inferred_modality.description: Modality inferred from the filename (see GET /catalog/modalities), or null if not detectable.

NiftiUploadProposal.title: NiftiUploadProposal
NiftiUploadProposal.description: Server-inferred metadata for a single uploaded NIfTI file.

default.title: Default
default.description: Default value if not supplied by the caller.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: Exhaustive list of allowed values, if constrained.

ParameterSpec.title: ParameterSpec
ParameterSpec.description: Specification for a single configurable parameter.

MRID.title: Mrid
MRID.description: Subject identifier. Must match the stem of uploaded NIfTI files.

ParticipantRow.title: ParticipantRow
ParticipantRow.description:
One row from participants.csv.

``MRID`` is required. Any additional columns (Age, Sex, MMSE, etc.) are
preserved as extra fields and round-trip through the API unchanged.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Complete replacement list. Each row must contain an 'MRID' key. Any additional keys are written as extra columns in participants.csv. Existing participants.csv is overwritten.

ParticipantsUpdate.title: ParticipantsUpdate
ParticipantsUpdate.description: Request body to replace the participants list.

download_path.title: Download Path
download_path.description: Relative path for use with GET /projects/{id}/files/download.

PerSubjectFileStatus.title: PerSubjectFileStatus
PerSubjectFileStatus.description: Availability of a single per-subject output file.

id.title: Id
id.description: Output identifier as declared in the pipeline results spec.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable label for this overlay, e.g. 'DLMUSE segmentation'. Use as a subtitle in the MRI panel (fall back to id when absent).

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Map of MRID → file availability and download path.

PerSubjectOutput.title: PerSubjectOutput
PerSubjectOutput.description: A named per-subject output type (e.g. a segmentation NIfTI).

input_notes.title: Input Notes
input_notes.description: Short user-facing notes about input requirements that readiness checks can't verify (e.g. 'Upload raw, unprocessed T1 images'). Plain text, shown verbatim. Empty when the pipeline declares none.

is_harmonized.title: Is Harmonized
is_harmonized.description: True if this pipeline applies harmonization to its inputs.

harmonized_variant.title: Harmonized Variant
harmonized_variant.description: Pipeline ID of the harmonized version of this pipeline. Present on base pipelines only; null on harmonized pipelines and those with no harmonized counterpart. Use to render a 'Switch to harmonized' action.

base_variant.title: Base Variant
base_variant.description: Pipeline ID of the standard (non-harmonized) version of this pipeline. Present on harmonized pipelines only; null on base pipelines and those with no base counterpart. Use to render a 'Switch to standard' action.

docs_id.title: Docs Id
docs_id.description: Documentation topic identifier for this pipeline. Use with GET /catalog/docs/{docs_id} to retrieve the manifest, and GET /catalog/docs/{docs_id}/{file} to fetch individual sections. Multiple pipelines may share the same docs_id (e.g. harmonized variants).

root_pipeline.title: Root Pipeline
root_pipeline.description: Grouping key for this pipeline, used to cluster related variants (e.g. base/harmonized/CVM flavours) under a single entry in the UI. Pipelines sharing the same root_pipeline belong to the same group; null if the pipeline YAML does not declare one.

harmonized.title: Harmonized
harmonized.description: True if this pipeline applies harmonization to its inputs. Explicit counterpart to the 'harmonized' category tag, for callers that want to filter/group variants without scanning categories.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Imaging/data modalities this pipeline requires (e.g. ['T1'], ['T1', 'FLAIR'], ['PET'], ['idat']), derived from its 'needs_*' prerequisites. Empty for pipelines with no modality requirement (e.g. the test pipeline).

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: User-overridable parameters for this pipeline. Each entry describes the type, default, and optional constraints. Pass values via ``params`` in the pipeline submit body. Step-level params in the YAML are fixed by the pipeline author and cannot be overridden.

min_subjects.description: Subject-count requirement declared by this pipeline, including any per-cohort constraints. Null when the pipeline declares no min_subjects requirement. Lets a client show what a pipeline needs before any data is uploaded; GET /projects/{id}/readiness/{pipeline_id} reports how a specific project measures up.

atlas_resource_path.title: Atlas Resource Path
atlas_resource_path.description: Resource path for the brain atlas NIfTI declared by this pipeline. Fetch with GET /catalog/resources/{path}. Null if no atlas is declared or the file is not present on the server.

atlas_segmentation_resource_path.title: Atlas Segmentation Resource Path
atlas_segmentation_resource_path.description: Resource path for the atlas segmentation NIfTI declared by this pipeline. Fetch with GET /catalog/resources/{path}. Null if no atlas segmentation is declared or the file is not present.

label_map.title: Label Map
label_map.description: Maps each batch-feature column name to its display name and, when the pipeline produces a segmentation, the constituent voxel label IDs in the atlas segmentation NIfTI. Null if no label_map resource is configured or the resource file is absent. Pipelines without segmentation output will have this field null.

feature_groups.title: Feature Groups
feature_groups.description: Ordered grouping of batch-feature columns for hierarchical UI display (e.g. nested dropdowns). Null if the pipeline does not declare feature_groups in its YAML.

column_schemas.title: Column Schemas
column_schemas.description: Validation schema for each column declared in csv_has_columns. Keyed by column name. Use this to drive client-side CSV validation: type checking, numeric range enforcement, and categorical value lists. Columns not listed here have no declared schema (accept any non-empty value).

PipelineDetail.title: PipelineDetail
PipelineDetail.description: Full pipeline definition including ordered steps and user-configurable parameters.

atlas_resource_path.title: Atlas Resource Path
atlas_resource_path.description: Resource path for the brain atlas NIfTI. Fetch with GET /catalog/resources/{path}.

atlas_segmentation_resource_path.title: Atlas Segmentation Resource Path
atlas_segmentation_resource_path.description: Resource path for the atlas segmentation NIfTI (reference-mode overlay when no subject data is selected). Fetch with GET /catalog/resources/{path}.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Per-subject completeness across all declared per_subject outputs.

PipelineResultDetail.title: PipelineResultDetail
PipelineResultDetail.description: Full result detail for one pipeline within a project.

has_batch_features.title: Has Batch Features
has_batch_features.description: True if the batch feature CSV exists in the project.

expected_batch_features_file.title: Expected Batch Features File
expected_batch_features_file.description: Project-relative path where this pipeline's batch feature CSV is expected (from the pipeline's results.batch_features.file). Present whenever the pipeline declares a batch_features spec, regardless of has_batch_features — lets the UI tell the user exactly what file is missing.

per_subject_ids.title: Per Subject Ids
per_subject_ids.description: IDs of declared per-subject output types.

has_atlas.title: Has Atlas
has_atlas.description: True if the atlas resource file is present on the server.

PipelineResultSummary.title: PipelineResultSummary
PipelineResultSummary.description: Quick summary of a pipeline's result availability within a project.

current_step.title: Current Step
current_step.description: Index of the step currently executing (0-based).

error.title: Error
error.description: Top-level error message if the run failed.

start_from_step.title: Start From Step
start_from_step.description: Step id the run was started at, if the caller requested one. Steps before it carry skip_reason 'forced'. Null for a normal full-pipeline run.

jobs_ahead.title: Jobs Ahead
jobs_ahead.description: Number of Batch jobs submitted before this one that are still waiting for compute capacity. Cloud mode only; null in local mode or when no step is currently pending on the Batch queue.

estimated_wait_seconds.title: Estimated Wait Seconds
estimated_wait_seconds.description: Estimated seconds until this job reaches the front of the queue, computed as the sum of (num_subjects × time_per_subject_seconds) for each job submitted ahead of this one. Null when timing data is unavailable for any ahead job.

PipelineRunDetail.title: PipelineRunDetail
PipelineRunDetail.description: Full pipeline run record including per-step breakdown.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Concatenated log output from all steps executed so far.

PipelineRunLogs.title: PipelineRunLogs
PipelineRunLogs.description: Aggregated logs for all completed steps in a pipeline run.

pipeline_id.title: Pipeline Id
pipeline_id.description: Pipeline identifier (matches a YAML basename in resources/pipelines/).

params.title: Params
params.description: Parameter overrides applied to every step that accepts them.

reuse_cached_steps.title: Reuse Cached Steps
reuse_cached_steps.description: When True, steps whose inputs haven't changed since the last successful run are skipped. Set to False to force a full re-run.

start_from_step.title: Start From Step
start_from_step.description: Advanced. Step id to start the run at. Every earlier step is marked skipped without any cache or output checks, and its declared outputs are assumed to be present at their resolved paths. The start step always runs (ignoring the cache); later steps follow reuse_cached_steps as normal. Null runs the whole pipeline. Returns 400 if the id is not one of the pipeline's steps.

PipelineRunSubmit.title: PipelineRunSubmit
PipelineRunSubmit.description: Request body to submit a pipeline run.

current_step.title: Current Step
current_step.description: Index of the step currently executing (0-based).

PipelineRunSummary.title: PipelineRunSummary
PipelineRunSummary.description: Abbreviated pipeline run record for list responses.

id.title: Id
id.description: Step identifier, unique within the pipeline.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable step name: the step's optional 'name' key in the pipeline YAML, falling back to the invoked tool's name. Null when neither exists — deliberately NOT the raw id, so a client can choose its own fallback.

description.title: Description
description.description: Step description: the step's optional 'description' key in the pipeline YAML, falling back to the invoked tool's description. Null when neither exists.

PipelineStep.title: PipelineStep
PipelineStep.description: A single step within a pipeline definition.

input_notes.title: Input Notes
input_notes.description: Short user-facing notes about input requirements that readiness checks can't verify (e.g. 'Upload raw, unprocessed T1 images'). Plain text, shown verbatim. Empty when the pipeline declares none.

is_harmonized.title: Is Harmonized
is_harmonized.description: True if this pipeline applies harmonization to its inputs.

harmonized_variant.title: Harmonized Variant
harmonized_variant.description: Pipeline ID of the harmonized version of this pipeline. Present on base pipelines only; null on harmonized pipelines and those with no harmonized counterpart. Use to render a 'Switch to harmonized' action.

base_variant.title: Base Variant
base_variant.description: Pipeline ID of the standard (non-harmonized) version of this pipeline. Present on harmonized pipelines only; null on base pipelines and those with no base counterpart. Use to render a 'Switch to standard' action.

docs_id.title: Docs Id
docs_id.description: Documentation topic identifier for this pipeline. Use with GET /catalog/docs/{docs_id} to retrieve the manifest, and GET /catalog/docs/{docs_id}/{file} to fetch individual sections. Multiple pipelines may share the same docs_id (e.g. harmonized variants).

root_pipeline.title: Root Pipeline
root_pipeline.description: Grouping key for this pipeline, used to cluster related variants (e.g. base/harmonized/CVM flavours) under a single entry in the UI. Pipelines sharing the same root_pipeline belong to the same group; null if the pipeline YAML does not declare one.

harmonized.title: Harmonized
harmonized.description: True if this pipeline applies harmonization to its inputs. Explicit counterpart to the 'harmonized' category tag, for callers that want to filter/group variants without scanning categories.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Imaging/data modalities this pipeline requires (e.g. ['T1'], ['T1', 'FLAIR'], ['PET'], ['idat']), derived from its 'needs_*' prerequisites. Empty for pipelines with no modality requirement (e.g. the test pipeline).

PipelineSummary.title: PipelineSummary
PipelineSummary.description: Abbreviated pipeline information for list responses.

name.title: Name
name.description: Project name. Used directly as the directory name and URL path segment. Must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,63}$.

ProjectCreate.title: ProjectCreate
ProjectCreate.description: Request body for creating a new project.

output_dir.title: Output Dir
output_dir.description: Project-relative path of the directory containing this _provenance.json.

generated_at.title: Generated At
generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the step finished.

execution_mode.title: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: Execution mode at time of run: 'local' or 'cloud'.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Cognito sub (cloud) or local user identifier of the user who ran the step.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Staleness check for each input path recorded at run time.

overall.title: Overall
overall.description: 'clean' — all inputs unchanged since the step ran. 'dirty' — at least one input was modified after the step. 'missing_inputs' — at least one input path no longer exists. 'unreadable' — the _provenance.json file could not be parsed.

error.title: Error
error.description: Parse error message, present only when overall='unreadable'.

ProvenanceEntry.title: ProvenanceEntry
ProvenanceEntry.description: Parsed and verified contents of one _provenance.json file.

label.title: Label
label.description: Mount label as declared in the tool YAML.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute host path recorded at run time.

status.title: Status
status.description: 'clean' — no files changed after the step finished. 'modified' — at least one file was written after the step's generated_at timestamp. 'missing' — the path no longer exists.

modified_count.title: Modified Count
modified_count.description: Number of files within the path that have been modified. Zero for 'clean' or 'missing' entries.

ProvenanceInputCheck.title: ProvenanceInputCheck
ProvenanceInputCheck.description: Staleness check for one input path recorded in a provenance file.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: One entry per _provenance.json file found in the project tree.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: 'all_clean' — every step's inputs are unchanged. 'some_dirty' — at least one step has stale or missing inputs. 'no_provenance' — no _provenance.json files found (no steps have completed yet).

ProvenanceReport.title: ProvenanceReport
ProvenanceReport.description: Provenance verification report for a project.

satisfied.title: Satisfied
satisfied.description: True if all hard requirements pass.

imaging.title: Imaging
imaging.description: One entry per imaging modality required by the pipeline.

complete_sets.description: Cross-modality completeness check. Present when the pipeline requires two or more imaging modalities. Reports which subjects have a full complement of required images.

idat.description: IDAT paired-file check. Present when the pipeline has a needs_idat requirement.

csv.description: CSV column checks, present only when the pipeline has csv_has_columns requirements.

subject_count.description: Subject count check, present only for pipelines with min_subjects requirements (e.g. harmonized pipelines). recommended_met=False blocks running (treated the same as a missing modality or CSV column), not just satisfied=False.

ReadinessReport.title: ReadinessReport
ReadinessReport.description: Project readiness check result for a specific pipeline.

ResourceSpec.title: ResourceSpec
ResourceSpec.description: Compute resources required by a tool.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: UTC timestamp when the project will be automatically deleted. Computed as the S3 LastModified of the heartbeat marker object plus PROJECT_RETENTION_DAYS. Refresh by calling POST /projects/{project_id}/retention/refresh.

atlas.title: Atlas
atlas.description: Atlas these indices belong to, e.g. 'muse'.

values.title: Values
values.description: ROIs in this list: integer indices (e.g. MUSE) or ROI names when the atlas's CSV columns are named by region (e.g. SynthSeg).

RoiList.title: RoiList
RoiList.description:
A curated sub-list of ROIs, used to narrow a prefix-based VarGroup.

Defined in ``resources/dicts/dict_roi_lists.yaml``.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Whether the project satisfies the pipeline's readiness requirements. A plan is still returned when false — each step's prediction remains meaningful — so this is informational.

subject_count.title: Subject Count
subject_count.description: Project-level subject count, using the same rule as the readiness check: the number of subjects complete across all required modalities when the pipeline needs two or more, otherwise the smallest per-modality imaging count. Per-step estimates use each step's own count (see RunPlanStep.subjects), which may differ.

estimated_total_seconds.title: Estimated Total Seconds
estimated_total_seconds.description: Sum of estimated_seconds over steps that would run. Assumes serial execution and does not divide by chunks or workers. Steps whose tool declares no timing contribute 0, so treat this as a LOWER BOUND and see steps_missing_timing for how many were unaccounted for. Never null.

estimated_full_seconds.title: Estimated Full Seconds
estimated_full_seconds.description: Same sum as if nothing were reused — the upper bound on reusable work. Excludes skip_forced steps. Untimed steps contribute 0 here too.

steps_missing_timing.title: Steps Missing Timing
steps_missing_timing.description: Steps that would run but whose tool declares neither time_per_subject_seconds nor fixed_seconds, and so contributed 0 to estimated_total_seconds. When above zero the total is a minimum; the steps themselves carry estimated_seconds: null.

steps_reused.title: Steps Reused
steps_reused.description: Steps predicted to be reused from cache.

RunPlan.title: RunPlan
RunPlan.description:
What a pipeline submission would do, without submitting it.

Read-only: creates no run record, submits no jobs, and does not touch the
step cache.

name.title: Name
name.description: Step display name (step YAML, else the tool's name).

action.title: Action
action.description: 'run' — the step would execute. 'reuse' — its cached result would be reused and nothing would execute. 'skip_forced' — it precedes start_from_step and would be skipped unchecked.

cached_from_run_id.title: Cached From Run Id
cached_from_run_id.description: Run that produced the cached result. Null unless will_reuse.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Short human-readable explanation of why the step would NOT be reused. One of: 'cache reuse disabled', 'no previous successful run', 'inputs changed since last run', 'inputs missing', 'outputs missing', 'upstream step will re-run', 'start step always runs'. Null when will_reuse, and null for skip_forced steps.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Subjects this step will process when the run reaches it — the number the real run will compute at that point, and therefore also what it will chunk on. The largest per-input count over the step's resolved inputs: a directory counts its .nii/.nii.gz files, a file always counts as 1, floored at 1. An input DIRECTORY that an earlier step is predicted to fill is credited with that step's count, since on disk it is still empty; file inputs are never inflated, because the real run counts a file as one subject whatever it contains. estimated_seconds is based on this, not on the project-level subject_count.

estimated_seconds.title: Estimated Seconds
estimated_seconds.description: time_per_subject_seconds x subjects for a step that would run; 0 for 'reuse' and 'skip_forced'. Null when the tool declares no timing.

time_per_subject_seconds.title: Time Per Subject Seconds
time_per_subject_seconds.description: Echoed from the tool spec. Null if the tool declares none.

fixed_seconds.title: Fixed Seconds
fixed_seconds.description: Echoed from the tool spec: one-off per-invocation cost independent of cohort size. estimated_seconds is fixed_seconds + time_per_subject_seconds x subjects, with either treated as 0 when absent.

parallelizable.title: Parallelizable
parallelizable.description: Whether the tool may be split into parallel chunks. Informational only: estimates assume serial execution.

subjects_per_chunk.title: Subjects Per Chunk
subjects_per_chunk.description: Tool's chunk size when parallelizable. Null when not chunked.

in_flight_elsewhere.title: In Flight Elsewhere
in_flight_elsewhere.description: An identical step (same cache key) is executing in another run right now. The real run would wait for it and then reuse its result, so this step may cost less than estimated_seconds. Not predicted as a reuse because the sibling could still fail.

missing_inputs.title: Missing Inputs
missing_inputs.description: Project-relative resolved input paths that do not exist on disk right now. Only populated for the start_from_step step, as a warning for the UI — it never blocks the plan or a submit.

RunPlanStep.title: RunPlanStep
RunPlanStep.description: Predicted treatment of one pipeline step, had the run been submitted now.

num_files.title: Num Files
num_files.description: Number of DICOM files belonging to this series.

SeriesInfo.title: SeriesInfo
SeriesInfo.description: Metadata for a single DICOM series detected in a staged upload.

series_uid.title: Series Uid
series_uid.description: SeriesInstanceUID of the series to convert.

mrid.title: Mrid
mrid.description: Output filename prefix (MRID). Defaults to the DICOM PatientID if not provided.

SeriesMapping.title: SeriesMapping
SeriesMapping.description: User-confirmed mapping from a DICOM series to a NiChart modality.

step_id.title: Step Id
step_id.description: Step identifier within the pipeline definition.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current execution state. 'partially_failed' means at least one chunk succeeded but at least one failed; the pipeline is halted and partial output is preserved.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Backend job ID. For non-parallelized steps only; null when the step runs as chunks. See 'chunks' for per-chunk job IDs.

container_image.title: Container Image
container_image.description: Container image used for this step.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if the step failed.

cached_from_run_id.title: Cached From Run Id
cached_from_run_id.description: Run ID that originally produced the cached output for this step. Only set when status is 'skipped' and the result was reused from a prior run.

skip_reason.title: Skip Reason
skip_reason.description: Why a 'skipped' step was skipped. 'cached' — its result was reused from the step cache (or coalesced onto an identical step running in another run). 'forced' — it precedes the run's start_from_step and was skipped without any checks. Null for steps that were not skipped.

total_chunks.title: Total Chunks
total_chunks.description: Total number of parallel chunks for this step. Null for non-parallelized steps.

completed_chunks.title: Completed Chunks
completed_chunks.description: Number of chunks that have succeeded so far.

failed_chunks.title: Failed Chunks
failed_chunks.description: Number of chunks that have failed.

total_subjects.title: Total Subjects
total_subjects.description: Total subjects assigned across all chunks.

subjects_complete.title: Subjects Complete
subjects_complete.description: Subjects in all succeeded chunks (guaranteed to have output).

chunks.title: Chunks
chunks.description: Per-chunk breakdown. Empty for non-parallelized steps.

StepStatus.title: StepStatus
StepStatus.description: Status record for a single pipeline step.

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: IDs of per_subject outputs that are missing for this subject.

SubjectCompleteness.title: SubjectCompleteness
SubjectCompleteness.description: Overall completeness of a subject's pipeline outputs.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable cohort name from the pipeline YAML, for display.

where.title: Where
where.description: Conditions defining this cohort, combined with AND.

actual.title: Actual
actual.description: Subjects with imaging whose CSV row matches every condition.

required.title: Required
required.description: Minimum matching subjects. Defaults to the parent min_subjects.required.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: Recommended matching subjects. Defaults to this constraint's required.

satisfied.title: Satisfied
satisfied.description: True if actual >= required and the cohort was evaluable.

recommended_met.title: Recommended Met
recommended_met.description: True if actual >= recommended and the cohort was evaluable.

unevaluable_reason.title: Unevaluable Reason
unevaluable_reason.description: Set when the cohort could not be evaluated at all — for example participants.csv is absent or lacks a column named by a condition. Distinguishes 'cannot tell' from a genuine count of zero.

SubjectConstraintCheck.title: SubjectConstraintCheck
SubjectConstraintCheck.description:
Readiness check for a minimum count of subjects matching a predicate.

Counts subjects present in BOTH the modality directories and participants.csv:
a subject with imaging but no covariate row cannot be evaluated and is not
counted, and neither is a CSV row with no imaging.

where.title: Where
where.description: Conditions defining this cohort, combined with AND.

required.title: Required
required.description: Minimum matching subjects needed to run at all.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: Recommended number of matching subjects for reliable results.

SubjectConstraintSpec.title: SubjectConstraintSpec
SubjectConstraintSpec.description:
A declared minimum number of subjects matching a predicate.

Only subjects that have imaging *and* a participants.csv row satisfying every
condition count towards this minimum.

actual.title: Actual
actual.description: Unique MRIDs detected across all modality directories.

required.title: Required
required.description: Minimum total subjects needed to run the pipeline at all.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.description: Recommended total number of subjects for reliable results.

satisfied.title: Satisfied
satisfied.description: True if the total meets required AND every entry in constraints is satisfied. Use this as the single gate for the whole subject-count requirement.

recommended_met.title: Recommended Met
recommended_met.description: True if the total meets recommended AND every constraint's recommended is met.

constraints.title: Constraints
constraints.description: Per-cohort minimum counts, e.g. 'at least 30 subjects with DX == CN'. Empty when the pipeline declares no constraints.

SubjectCountRequirement.title: SubjectCountRequirement
SubjectCountRequirement.description: Readiness check for a minimum subject count, used by harmonized pipelines.

column.title: Column
column.description: participants.csv column this condition applies to.

equals.title: Equals
equals.description: Cell must equal this value, compared case-insensitively.

in.title: In
in.description: Cell must be one of these values, compared case-insensitively.

min.title: Min
min.description: Inclusive numeric lower bound. Null means unbounded.

max.title: Max
max.description: Inclusive numeric upper bound. Null means unbounded.

SubjectPredicate.title: SubjectPredicate
SubjectPredicate.description:
One condition on a participants.csv column, used to define a subject cohort.

Conditions combine with AND within a single constraint. String comparisons
(``equals``, ``in``) are case-insensitive and whitespace-stripped; numeric
bounds (``min``, ``max``) are inclusive, matching ColumnSpec.

time_per_subject_seconds.title: Time Per Subject Seconds
time_per_subject_seconds.description: Expected wall-clock seconds to process one subject. Used by GET /cloud/status to estimate queue-drain time.

fixed_seconds.title: Fixed Seconds
fixed_seconds.description: One-off wall-clock seconds per invocation regardless of cohort size — container start, model loading, interpreter warm-up. A run's estimate is fixed_seconds + time_per_subject_seconds x subjects. Tools whose cost is almost entirely startup declare only this.

parallelizable.title: Parallelizable
parallelizable.description: When True, the pipeline orchestrator may split directory inputs into subject chunks and run them as parallel backend jobs, then merge the results.

subjects_per_chunk.title: Subjects Per Chunk
subjects_per_chunk.description: Default number of subjects per parallel chunk for this tool. Null means use the server global default (10). Only meaningful when parallelizable is True.

github_url.title: Github Url
github_url.description: Link to the tool's source code repository on GitHub.

ToolSummary.title: ToolSummary
ToolSummary.description: Abbreviated tool information for list responses.

UserInfo.title: UserInfo
UserInfo.description: Safe user claims returned by GET /auth/me. The raw token is never included.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable group name shown in the category selector.

category.title: Category
category.description: Coarse bucket for UI sectioning, e.g. 'demog', 'biomarker', 'roi'.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Pipeline IDs these variables come from; empty for cross-pipeline groups like demographics.

vtype.title: Vtype
vtype.description: 'name' for flat named variables; unset/null for ROI-indexed groups.

values.title: Values
values.description: Explicit raw column names belonging to this group. Mutually exclusive with prefix.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Column-name prefix for ROI-indexed variables, e.g. 'DL_MUSE_Volume_'. May be empty ('') when the CSV columns are the ROI names themselves (e.g. SynthSeg). Mutually exclusive with values.

atlas.title: Atlas
atlas.description: For prefix-based groups: the atlas whose roi_lists apply to this group (matches RoiList.atlas), e.g. 'muse' or 'synthseg'.

VarGroup.title: VarGroup
VarGroup.description:
A curated, cross-pipeline group of related variables.

Defined in ``resources/dicts/dict_var_groups.yaml``. Each group is either a flat
list of explicitly named variables (``values``, e.g. SPARE scores) or a
prefix-based group of ROI-indexed variables (``prefix``, e.g. DLMUSE volumes) —
never both. For prefix-based groups, combine ``prefix`` with a ROI index from one
of ``roi_lists`` on ``VarGroupCatalogResponse`` to build a candidate raw column
name, then resolve its display name via the owning pipeline's ``label_map``.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: All curated variable groups, keyed by group id.

roi_lists.title: Roi Lists
roi_lists.description: All curated ROI sub-lists, keyed by list id.
